gbm_population_evidence.quote: Histologically confirmed diagnosis of GBM according to WHO 2016 classification criteria.

candidate_evidence.quote: Optune® is a commercial, portable, battery-operated device intended for continuous home use, which delivers TTFields at a frequency of 200kHz to the brain by means of insulated transducer arrays.

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: Pivotal, Randomized, Open-label Study of Optune® (Tumor Treating Fields) Concomitant With RT & TMZ for the Treatment of Newly Diagnosed GBM

role_evidence.quote: All patients are to receive standard RT and TMZ treatment followed by maintenance TMZ chemotherapy and Optune® according to the current standard of care regimen.

coder_notes: Device (TTFields) trial; only registered intervention is a device. Temozolomide is not a registered intervention but the text states all patients receive it, so listed as soc_backbone. Tumour samples are tested for randomisation but no biomarker is named.
